summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Avatar feature (Settings → Avatars). All backend APIs (GET/POST/DELETE) and frontend UI components pass all tests. 17/17 backend tests passed, frontend UI verification completed successfully.
passed_tests: GET /api/avatars returns 3 avatars with correct structure
Avatars have correct IDs (avatar-1, avatar-2, avatar-3)
Avatars have correct names (Avatar 1, Avatar 2, Avatar 3)
POST /api/avatars/{id}/photo uploads image and stores as base64
POST /api/avatars/{id}/photo rejects files > 2MB (400 error)
POST /api/avatars/{id}/photo rejects invalid mime types (400 error)
POST /api/avatars/{id}/photo returns 404 for non-existent avatar
Upload requires admin role (403 for Editor)
DELETE /api/avatars/{id}/photo removes photo from avatar
DELETE requires admin role (403 for Editor)
DELETE returns 400 if avatar has no photo
All avatar endpoints require authentication (401/403)
Settings page has Users and Avatars tabs
Avatars settings page shows all 3 avatar cards
Avatar upload buttons are visible and functional
Avatar remove buttons appear when photo is set
Tasks list shows avatar thumbnails in Avatar column
Create Task modal shows avatar thumbnails in dropdown
Task Details header shows avatar thumbnail
Task Details avatar dropdown shows thumbnails
seed_data_creation: Backend auto-seeds 3 avatars on startup if missing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Avatar feature fully tested. Backend stores avatar photos as base64 in MongoDB. Frontend uses AvatarContext provider to share avatar data globally. AvatarDisplay component shows thumbnails throughout the app. All interactive elements have data-testid attributes for testing.

backend_endpoints.DELETE /api/avatars/{id}/photo: PASS - Admin-only delete, returns 204 on success, 400 if no photo

frontend_ui.Task Details header: PASS - Shows avatar thumbnail next to task title
